Vex

the Gloomist

Vex is a gloomy yordle who punishes mobile champions. Every time an enemy dashes near her, she marks them, and her empowered spells fear and interrupt dashes. Her ultimate lets her dash onto someone and reset if they die. Easy to learn, and a nightmare for assassins and divers.

When to pick Vex

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Better as a counter-pick against dashing champions; she struggles against long-range mages.

Pick into

  • Dash-heavy mids like Yone, Akali and Irelia
  • Teams full of divers and assassins
  • Mobile junglers who rely on dashes to gank

Avoid into

  • Immobile, long-range mages who poke her
  • Champions who beat her trades like Vladimir and Annie
  • Teams with few dashes, where her passive does little

Great teammates

AmumuHis crowd control sets up Vex's burst.
LeonaHer engage gives Vex easy targets for Shadow Surge.
JinxVex protects Jinx from divers.

Your team needs: Some engage, and a backline Vex can protect from divers.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Hard counter to dashing champions: her passive fear interrupts them
  • Simple, strong combo with a lot of burst
  • Shadow Surge resets on a kill, so she can chain through teamfights
  • Personal Space shields her when enemies jump in

Weaknesses

  • Short range compared to artillery mages
  • Struggles against long-range poke and immobile mages
  • Her ultimate dash puts her in danger if the target doesn't die
  • Needs her fear ready; without it she's much weaker against divers

Power spikes

  • Level 3: full combo and strong trades
  • Level 6: Shadow Surge lets you dash in for kills and reset
  • First item (Luden's Echo): more burst and wave clear
  • Two items (Shadowflame): you can one-shot squishy carries
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): survive after diving in with your ultimate

Top tips

  • Always know whether your passive fear is ready
  • Gloom with E first so Q and W deal bonus damage
  • Use Personal Space defensively when assassins jump on you
  • Shadow Surge resets on kills: look for low targets to chain
  • Lead Mistral Bolt slightly because it speeds up
  • Pick Vex when the enemy team has lots of dashes
